Name: Automatic Size
Description: Automatically determines the optimal export resolution for Unreal Engine based on the input terrain and project settings.

Name: Target Size
Description: Specifies the desired export resolution for Unreal Engine heightmaps and textures. Choose from standard Unreal-compatible sizes for best results.

Flubs.Name: x8129
Flubs.Description: Exports at 8129 x 8129 pixels, suitable for very large landscapes in Unreal Engine.

Flubs.Name: x4033
Flubs.Description: Exports at 4033 x 4033 pixels, commonly used for large terrain tiles.

Flubs.Name: x2017
Flubs.Description: Exports at 2017 x 2017 pixels, ideal for medium-sized terrain tiles.

Flubs.Name: x1009
Flubs.Description: Exports at 1009 x 1009 pixels, suitable for smaller terrain tiles or test scenes.

Flubs.Name: x505
Flubs.Description: Exports at 505 x 505 pixels, used for small terrain tiles or prototyping.

Name: Dont Resize Textures
Description: Prevents automatic resizing of textures during export, preserving the original resolution of input textures.

Name: LOD Info
Description: Provides Level of Detail (LOD) information for exported terrain, enabling optimized rendering and streaming in Unreal Engine.

Name: Format
Description: Selects the file format for exported terrain data. Choose the format that best matches your Unreal Engine workflow.

Flubs.Name: PNG
Flubs.Description: Exports terrain data as PNG images, suitable for color maps and masks.

Flubs.Name: R16
Flubs.Description: Exports terrain data as 16-bit RAW files, recommended for heightmaps to preserve elevation detail.

Flubs.Name: RAW
Flubs.Description: Exports terrain data as RAW files, compatible with Unreal Engine for heightmaps and other data.

Name: Naming
Description: Group for naming conventions and options for exported files, ensuring compatibility and clarity in Unreal Engine projects.

Name: Unreal Friendly Naming
Description: Applies Unreal Engine-compatible naming conventions to exported files for easier import and organization.

Name: Map 1-10
Description: Defines an exported map layer, such as height, mask, color, or weight. Configure each layer for Unreal Engine import.

Flubs.Name: Height
Flubs.Description: Exports the heightmap layer, representing terrain elevation for Unreal Engine landscapes.

Flubs.Name: Mask
Flubs.Description: Exports a mask layer, used for material blending or selective placement in Unreal Engine.

Flubs.Name: Color
Flubs.Description: Exports a color map layer, providing surface color information for terrain texturing.

Flubs.Name: Weight
Flubs.Description: Exports a weight map layer, used for controlling material distribution or foliage placement.

Name: Add Input
Description: Adds an additional input map layer for export, allowing for more complex terrain data to be sent to Unreal Engine.

Name: Information
Description: Group for informational parameters and metadata about the export process.

Name: Information 2
Description: Additional metadata or notes related to the Unreal Engine export process.

Name: Information 1
Description: General information or notes about the Unreal Engine export settings.
